monuments.name: Stonehenge
monuments.description: Prehistoric ring of standing sarsen stones on Salisbury Plain, England (c. 3000–2000 BC).

monuments.name: Ahu Tongariki
monuments.description: The largest ceremonial platform on Rapa Nui (Easter Island), with fifteen moai.

monuments.name: Arc de Triomphe
monuments.description: Triumphal arch at the western end of the Champs-Élysées, Paris (completed 1836).

monuments.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
monuments.description: Freestanding bell tower of Pisa Cathedral, famous for its tilt (1173–1372).

monuments.name: Big Ben
monuments.description: The Great Bell and clock tower (Elizabeth Tower) of the Palace of Westminster, London (1859).

monuments.name: Parthenon
monuments.description: Doric temple to Athena on the Acropolis of Athens (447–432 BC).

monuments.name: Statue of Liberty
monuments.description: Copper statue by Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi on Liberty Island, New York Harbor (1886).

monuments.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
monuments.description: Nineteenth-century Romanesque Revival palace above Hohenschwangau, Bavaria.

monuments.name: El Castillo (Temple of Kukulcan)
monuments.description: Step pyramid at the heart of the Maya city of Chichén Itzá, Yucatán.

monuments.name: Colosseum
monuments.description: Elliptical amphitheatre in the centre of Rome (completed AD 80).

monuments.name: Al-Khazneh (The Treasury)
monuments.description: Temple façade carved into sandstone in the Nabataean city of Petra, Jordan.

monuments.name: St. Basil’s Cathedral
monuments.description: Church with colourful onion domes on Red Square, Moscow (1555–1561).

monuments.name: Eiffel Tower
monuments.description: Wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, Paris (1889).

monuments.name: Taj Mahal
monuments.description: White marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river, Agra (1631–1653).

monuments.name: Angkor Wat
monuments.description: Twelfth-century temple complex in Siem Reap, Cambodia — the largest religious monument in the world.

monuments.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
monuments.description: The oldest and largest of the Giza pyramids (c. 2560 BC), the last surviving ancient wonder.

monuments.name: Machu Picchu
monuments.description: Fifteenth-century Inca citadel on a ridge above the Urubamba valley, Peru.

monuments.name: Hagia Sophia
monuments.description: Domed building in Istanbul, completed in AD 537 under Justinian I.

skins.name: Classic Road Atlas

skins.name: Soft Terrain
skins.description: Muted sage and clay tones with gentle, low-contrast labels.

skins.name: Ocean Cartographer
skins.description: Deep marine blues, sea-glass land and fine navy linework.

skins.name: Woodland Trails
skins.description: Forest greens, bark-brown paths and moss-coloured parks.

skins.name: Desert Expedition
skins.description: Sun-baked ochre land, terracotta roads and oasis-blue water.

skins.name: Midnight Navigator
skins.description: Night-mode cartography: ink-blue land, glowing amber roads.

skins.name: Vintage Survey
skins.description: A survey sheet on aged paper: sepia ink and italic labels.

skins.name: Alpine Explorer
skins.description: Glacier whites, slate roads and icy lake blues.

skins.name: Golden Cartography
skins.description: Gilded linework on deep green, like an illuminated chart.

skins.name: Imperial Atlas
skins.description: Crimson and ivory with gold borders — a ceremonial state atlas.

skins.name: Celestial Routes
skins.description: A star chart: midnight sky, star-field background and a navigational grid.

skins.name: Royal Treasure Map
skins.description: Parchment texture, burnt-umber ink and red-dashed routes.

skins.name: Deep-Sea Navigator
skins.description: Bioluminescent teal linework over abyssal blue.

skins.name: Ancient World Atlas
skins.description: Faded fresco tones and serif-italic labels of an old world atlas.

skins.name: Living Parchment
skins.description: Hand-inked parchment with a vignette and graticule grid.

skins.name: Astral Cartographer
skins.description: Violet nebula land, star-field sky and luminous constellation routes.

skins.name: Worldmaker’s Atlas
skins.description: Jewel-toned continents, golden roads and a parchment-and-gold frame.
